changelog:
executing-plans 1.0.2

- Improved documentation with detailed compliance layer and operational process.
- Clearer trigger conditions: only execute sequential written plans, no subagents.
- Explicit stop-and-ask policy for blockers or unclear instructions.
- Expanded section on verification, error recovery, and reporting flow.
- Added usage guidance: when to use, when not to use, and best practices.
- Increased emphasis on following plans exactly and never guessing.
summary: Gunakan saat ada rencana implementasi tertulis (dari writing-plans) dan harus dieksekusi langkah demi langkah di sesi saat ini—tanpa subagent. Aktif saat user bilang 'jalankan plan ini', 'eksekusi todos', atau 'implementasikan sesuai plan'. Hentikan & tanya bila ada blocker.
